brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full base piece:0,0,0;full closed on top by solid cover cover:0,0,0;full;top, all open side faces capped by capOpenFaces (6 caps cap:0,0,0;*), joints locked with lockJoints. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre hex-port-louvre fitted as port:0#0,0#0 on slot 0 of the base — vents a closed cell while shedding rain per catalog. A cable plate (hex-port-gland, port:0#0,0#1) on the adjacent slot gives the board a way to be wired in without opening the box.

No circuit-board/PCB prop exists in find_props (search returned only unrelated props), so no board prop was placed; the enclosure interior is empty and sized to receive a real board. No material, heat, waterproofing or electrical-safety rating is claimed — the configurator checks fit only and parts are printed in a user-chosen material.

finish.summary: A single-cell closed electronics enclosure: full hex base with a solid top cover, all remaining open faces capped and joints locked, a louvred port on one side so the interior can breathe, and a cable plate on the adjacent side for wiring entry. Verified with check_build (no issues, meshClash clear). No PCB prop exists to stage the board, and no material/heat/waterproofing performance is claimed.

events.text: Closed electronics box with a louvred vent for the board — I'll survey the enclosure parts and vent options to build it sealed but breathing.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

events.text: Enclosure is capped and locked with the louvre and cable plate fitted. Now I'll view it and run the final check.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
